dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you cause some kind of disaster?

dialogues.speaker: Vuillermoz
dialogues.text: I didn't do anything, but it's just that... I really think they're going to fire me.

dialogues.speaker: Vuillermoz
dialogues.text: I've never felt like I truly deserve to be at the Institute. And that feeling is getting stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Vuillermoz
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm no outstanding genius like you, you even earned the title of Honorary Senior Researcher...
